landing.badge: Build the habit, one day at a time
landing.hero.lead: Nihongo Diary helps Japanese learners build a daily writing habit with AI corrections, saved diary history, calendar tracking, and learning support from Obie.
landing.hero.subtext: No credit card needed · Free to start
landing.problem.label: The problem
landing.problem.h2: You've studied the grammar. You still freeze when you write.
landing.problem.body: Most learners read and listen far more than they produce. Without real writing and honest feedback, the same mistakes repeat — and motivation quietly fades when no one is there to say "close, try this."
landing.solution.label: The solution
landing.solution.h2: A small diary today beats a perfect essay someday.
landing.solution.body: Write a few honest lines in Japanese. Obie corrects them, shows you a natural version, and points out exactly what to fix. Save it, and tomorrow you do it again. That loop is how fluency is actually built.
landing.solution.li1: Write at your own level, from N5 to natural
landing.solution.li2: See corrections and a native-style rewrite side by side
landing.solution.li3: Keep everything, and watch the calendar fill up

landing.features.h2: Everything you need to keep writing.
landing.feature.ai.title: Instant AI corrections
landing.feature.ai.body: Get a corrected version, a natural native rewrite, and clear notes the moment you finish writing.

landing.feature.calendar.title: Calendar & streaks

landing.feature.obie.title: Learning support from Obie
landing.feature.obie.body: Templates, key ideas, and friendly tips from Obie help you start writing even on the days you feel stuck.

landing.feature.habit.title: Built for daily habit
landing.feature.habit.body: Three sentences is a great day. Nihongo Diary is designed around small wins, not perfect essays.
landing.steps.label: How it works
landing.step1.title: Write a few lines
landing.step1.body: Open today's diary and write in Japanese — as little as one sentence is enough to count.
landing.step2.title: Get natural corrections

landing.step4.title: Watch your streak grow
landing.step4.body: Each day fills your calendar. Small daily writing compounds into real, lasting fluency.

lp.hero.h1a: The hardest part of Japanese isn't learning it.
lp.hero.h1b: It's knowing if you got it right — and having a reason to keep going.
lp.hero.subhead: That's exactly what Nihongo Diary is for. Write a diary in Japanese, get it corrected instantly, and keep going alongside other learners.
lp.hero.microcopy: No credit card needed — write your first diary today.
lp.problem.h2: You can study Japanese for years and still freeze the moment you try to use it.
lp.problem.body1: Input is everywhere — textbooks, apps, videos, flashcards. Output is the problem. The moment you try to actually produce Japanese, two things stop you:
lp.problem.body2: The problem is output. The moment you try to actually produce Japanese — write a real sentence, say something that matters — two things stop you:
lp.problem.bullet1: 1. You write something… but you have no idea if it's right. No one's there to check. So the mistake just becomes a habit.
lp.problem.bullet2: 2. You promise yourself you'll practice every day… and alone, you quietly stop. Not because you're lazy. Because no one's doing it with you.
lp.problem.body3: This is the output wall. It isn't a talent problem or a motivation problem. It's that the one skill that matters most — output — is the one thing no app ever really helped you with.
lp.solution.h2: So we built Nihongo Diary around those exact two problems.
lp.solution.intro: Not another way to study. A way to finally output — and get the two things that were always missing.
lp.solution.p1.title: Get it corrected
lp.solution.p1.body: Write in Japanese. The moment you finish, you get it back — corrected. That's the answer-check that was always missing.
lp.solution.p2.title: You're not doing it alone
lp.solution.p2.body: See real diaries from other learners. React, comment, follow. Share your own and receive peer corrections on top of AI ones — two layers of feedback, from the machine and from people who've been where you are. Their mistakes become your lessons. Your streak has witnesses.
lp.solution.p3.title: Your voice, too
lp.solution.p3.body: Some days you'd rather speak than type. Record your diary out loud and keep it. Output isn't only writing — it's getting your mouth used to Japanese, too.
lp.features.h2: Everything you need to output — nothing you don't.
lp.features.moreH2: Everything else that keeps you going

lp.testimonials.t1.body: I've kept a little Japanese diary for three months — writing every day and getting it corrected. It's the best way to learn everyday words and practice grammar.
lp.testimonials.t1.name: Simone
lp.testimonials.t2.body: I'd wanted to do daily writing practice and keep a journal. This solved two problems at once.
lp.testimonials.t2.name: Matthew
lp.testimonials.t3.body: Such a cool idea. I love the order — original, natural rewrite, teacher's notes, key mistakes, vocab, then a practice sentence.
lp.testimonials.t3.name: Jamie
lp.teacher.name: Tetsu Sensei — Japanese teacher, Sapporo
lp.teacher.body1: I'm a Japanese teacher. But before that, I was an English learner who hit the exact wall I just described.
lp.teacher.body2: I learned the hard way that real progress comes down to three things: input, output, repeat. Input was easy. Output was where I got stuck — because I could never check if what I produced was actually right, and alone, I always quit.
lp.teacher.body3: The one thing I managed to keep doing was writing a diary. And I kept thinking: if only I could record it by voice too, and if only someone could check it the moment I wrote it.
lp.teacher.body4: So I built the thing I always wanted — for my own students, and for every learner stuck at the same wall. A current teacher who was once a learner, making the tool he actually needed. That's Nihongo Diary.
lp.teacher.cta: Watch how I teach on YouTube →

guide.intro.p1: The idea is simple. You write about your day — in Japanese. That's it.
guide.intro.p2: Then your diary is corrected automatically. Not just grammar — natural Japanese. Everything you learn comes from your own words.
guide.write.title: Write your diary
guide.write.body: Write about your day in Japanese. Short is fine. Choose your level (N5–Natural) and style, and add a photo or voice note if you like.
guide.correct.title: Get AI corrections
guide.correct.body: Your diary becomes natural Japanese. Compare your sentence with a native version, read the Teacher's Note that explains why it changed, and see common mistakes — all based on your own writing.
guide.recheck.title: Rewrite & recheck
guide.recheck.body: Right after a correction, rewrite your diary and check again. You'll see what improved and what still needs work.
guide.vocab.title: Save words to your Vocabulary
guide.vocab.body: In the "Next words & grammar to try" section of your correction, tap ＋ to save new words and grammar. Review them anytime in History → My Vocabulary, with example sentences and practice quizzes.
guide.tapTranslate.title: Tap to translate
guide.tapTranslate.body: When you read another learner's diary in the Feed, switch on "Tap a word" and tap any word to see its meaning. Works on their natural Japanese and in comments.
guide.obie.title: Obie cheers you on
guide.obie.body: Obie reacts to what you wrote and shares a daily phrase. Obie also reminds you if you haven't written yet, and celebrates your streaks.
guide.calendar.title: Your calendar
guide.calendar.body: Every diary is saved on a calendar, so you can watch your streak grow and see yourself improve.
guide.feed.title: Community feed
guide.feed.body: Read diaries from other learners you follow. Seeing how others write is great practice — and learning is more fun when you're not alone.
guide.social.title: Comments & reactions
guide.social.body: Leave comments and reactions on public diaries. You'll get a notification when someone reacts or replies to you.
guide.peer.title: Correct each other
guide.peer.body: On another learner's public diary, tap "Add a correction" to help them — select the part to fix, suggest a correction, and add a comment. Others can correct your diary too. Teaching is one of the best ways to learn.
guide.report.title: Weekly Report
guide.report.body: A weekly look back at your writing — your writing days and learning trends.
guide.lessons.title: Mini Lessons
guide.lessons.body: 20 short lessons on grammar and expressions, from hiragana to verb forms.
guide.planNote: Some features have limits or full versions depending on your plan.
tour.welcome.title: Welcome to Nihongo Diary
tour.welcome.desc: A quick tour of the app — about a minute. You can skip any time.
tour.writeCta.title: Start with today's diary
tour.writeCta.desc: Press the highlighted button to open the diary editor.
tour.editor.title: Choose Level and Style
tour.editor.desc: Pick your Level (N5–Natural) and Style, then write about your day in Japanese. One sentence is plenty.
tour.correct.title: Get an AI correction
tour.correct.desc: When you are done, press "Correct with AI". You get a corrected version, a more natural rewrite, and an explanation.
tour.feedTab.title: Read other learners' diaries
tour.feed.title: The Feed
tour.feed.desc: Public diaries from other learners. React, leave a correction, and follow the people you like.
tour.done.title: That's it!
tour.done.desc: You can reopen this guide any time from How to Use. Enjoy your writing!
tour.sample.note: Example result — your diary has not been corrected yet.
welcomePlans.label: Plans
welcomePlans.title: Your free account is ready
welcomePlans.description: Everything here is optional — the free plan is yours to keep. Take a look at what Plus and Pro add, or jump straight in. 🌸
welcomePlans.skipHint: You can see plans any time from your profile.
plans.note.recheckUnit: Free resets each day; paid resets with every new correction.
plans.note.translationsShared: Full-entry and tap translations share this count. An entry you have already translated re-opens for free — every word you tap counts.
plans.a11y.caption: Feature comparison by plan
plans.footer.commonFeatures: Every plan includes unlimited diary saves with photos and places, full correction details, next-word and grammar suggestions, Obie, and recording yourself reading aloud.
plans.footer.commonSocial: The community side is unlimited on every plan too — Feed, Discovery, follows, reactions, comments and replies, peer corrections, and invite links.
plans.teacher.title: Teacher · Coming soon
plans.teacher.desc: Everything in Pro, plus personal feedback from Tetsu-sensei. Limited spots.
plans.note.practiceDrills: Exercises built from your own correction and shown with it.
plans.note.miniLessonInCorrection: A grammar lesson matched to the mistake in your correction.
plans.note.lessonLibrary: The 20 lessons you can read on the Support tab.
plans.note.reviewDrills: AI-generated drills for a mini lesson, on the Support tab. Pro only.
plans.note.audio: Only new audio counts. Anything you have already heard replays for free, as often as you like.
plans.note.audioScope: Free hears one sentence of the natural version, plus the new words themselves. Plus and Pro also hear the whole text, your mistakes before and after, and the example sentences.
plans.note.wordLookup: Look up an English word while you write. Only new words count — ones you have looked up before stay free.
plans.note.weeklyReport: Free shows how many days you wrote. Plus and Pro add your most-used words, notes on your recurring mistakes, AI suggestions, and your streak. Your streak itself always shows on the dashboard, on every plan.
write.savedWords.label: Your saved words
learned.usedTitle: You used a word you saved!
learned.usedSubtitle: Use it three times and it graduates from your list.
learned.graduatedBody: Three diaries, three uses. This one is part of your Japanese now. 🐶
audio.limitReached: That is today’s audio. Sentences you have already heard still replay for free.
audio.wholeOnPaid: Plus and Pro play the whole text.
audio.playBeforeAfter: Play the mistake and the correction
dictation.title: Listening practice
dictation.listenBody: One sentence from your own diary, in its corrected form. Play it as many times as you need — replays are free.
dictation.writeHint: Kanji or kana, either is fine. Punctuation and spaces are ignored.
dictation.noneLeft: That is today’s new audio. This sentence still replays for free, as often as you like.
dictation.unavailableHint: This entry has no correction yet, or its correction was saved without readings.
dictation.ctaHint: Hear a sentence from this diary and write it down
dictation.secondTry: You have heard this one before. Listen once more and give it another go — the second time is the one that sticks.
audioIntro.title: New: Listen and write
audioIntro.body1: You can now hear your corrections read aloud — the natural version, your mistakes side by side, and new words. Your vocabulary list can be read aloud too.
audioIntro.body2: There is also a new dictation exercise: listen to a sentence from your diary and write what you hear.
audioIntro.limit: Free covers one new sentence a day. Plus and Pro are unlimited.
audioIntro.limitIos: Free covers one new sentence a day.
notification.streak.title: 🔥 {n}-day streak
notification.streak.body: Today is still empty. One sentence keeps it going.
notification.streak.bodyDayOne: One sentence today makes it two.
audio.moreOnPaid: Plus and Pro also read your mistakes and example sentences aloud.
wordLookup.limitReached: That is today’s lookups. Words you have already looked up are still free.
wordLookup.moreOnPaid: Plus and Pro look up as many as you like.
